audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven stages is given to Volibear in both layers, while Sejuani wins the matchup 57% over 100 games and the entry's own prose says 'Once you hit Level 6 this lane is comfortably yours' and 'you are simply harder to kill than he is'.
audit.why: The chart directly contradicts both the record and the paragraph next to it. The packet's levelChart reads Volibear / Skill / Sejuani / Skill / Sejuani / Sejuani / Sejuani, which matches the prose: Level 3 is where the full Winter's Wrath into Permafrost chain arrives, Level 6 is Glacial Prison, and from the first tank item Frenzied Maul's 5-second heal cannot keep pace. A player reading a chart that says he loses every stage of a lane he wins 57% of the time stops trusting the page.
audit.corrected: Level 3, Level 6, First item and 2+ items belong to Sejuani; Level 2 and Levels 4-5 are even; only Level 1 is Volibear's.
sources: champ-data/content/sejuani.js (mid and late paragraphs of this entry)

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 1-2 spike calls Thundering Smash a 'Q empowered dash' and the Level 3 spike times the combo against 'a full E charge'. Sky Splitter is not a chargeable ability, and Thundering Smash is not a dash.
audit.why: Thundering Smash gives Volibear ramping move speed toward enemies and stuns the first one he attacks — the stun is delivered by an auto-attack, not by the cast, and there is no leap to dodge. Sky Splitter is a 16-second flat-cooldown lightning bolt with a fixed cast, so 'a full E charge' describes a mechanic that does not exist. Both errors point the Sejuani player at the wrong tell: he watches for a dash animation that never comes and waits out a charge bar that is not there.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash: 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, ramping speed toward you, stun on his next attack. Sky Splitter: 16s flat, no charge.
sources: champ-data/_kits/volibear.json (Thundering Smash 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks'; Sky Splitter cd 16)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer refers three times to 'his E hand-of-the-god stun'. Sky Splitter does not stun. It damages, slows, and shields Volibear if he is standing inside the blast radius. Volibear's only stun is Thundering Smash (Q).
audit.why: This is the most damaging error in the entry, because it is the reason it gives for conceding levels 4-5 and for not committing the Permafrost chain. A Sejuani player who believes Sky Splitter stuns will refuse trades that are actually free, and — worse — will not realise the real interaction: Sky Splitter only shields him when he stands in his own blast, so if he casts it on top of you and steps out, he has taken the cooldown and gained nothing. That is the moment to commit, and the entry currently teaches the opposite.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter does not stun. It slows and it shields him only if he is inside the blast radius — if he throws it and stays out, he has no shield and the trade is yours.
sources: champ-data/_kits/volibear.json (Sky Splitter: 'dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius'; hardCC flag sits on Q only)

audit.whatIsWrong: Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects and its cooldown is 5 seconds flat at every rank; the entry calls it 'W bite heal' throughout and never names it, never times it, and never says it carries on-hit. Grievous Wounds is not mentioned anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: A 5-second heal is not something you out-wait, it is something you out-pace or shut off, and the entry's whole plan for levels 1-5 is to wait it out. Because Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects, his damage scales with attack speed on top of The Relentless Storm's stacking attack speed, so buying flat armour reads the extended trade wrong. Anti-heal is the actual answer and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul is 5s flat, applies on-hit, and the second bite on the same target heals him — buy Grievous Wounds rather than trying to out-wait it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/volibear.json (Frenzied Maul cd 5, 'applying on-hit effects', heal flag; The Relentless Storm grants attack speed)
champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json (needs-antiheal, onhit-itemization, shield-absorbs-burst for sejuani vs volibear)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Thundering Smash as the matchup-defining cooldown and gives no number for it or for anything else, and the packet flags that the entry never names any of Volibear's five abilities.
audit.why: The advice 'step up only on its downtime' is unusable without the downtime. Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 falling to 10s, Sky Splitter is 16s flat, and Stormbringer is 160/135/110 — the longest ultimate cooldown either champion has, and the reason his tower-disable dive is a once-per-teamfight threat rather than a standing one.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Sky Splitter 16s flat, Frenzied Maul 5s flat, Stormbringer 160/135/110s.

edits.before: Volibear's Q empowered dash closes distance before your Q is reliable — he can run you down pre-Frost-stack and win the short trade with his W bite heal.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is no dash — he ramps speed at you and the stun lands on his next attack, 12s at rank 1, and Frenzied Maul bites the trade back at 5s flat.

edits.after: Arctic Assault into both Winter's Wrath arcs into Permafrost is your first real combo — land it while Sky Splitter is down, 16s flat, and you win the exchange.

edits.before: Bait his Q empowered dash before committing your own Q Arctic Assault so you don't collide mid-trade with no escape
edits.after: Bait Thundering Smash — 12s at rank 1 — before you spend Arctic Assault, or you eat the stun with no exit

edits.before: Use Q empowered dash to close before you stack Frost and win the pre-combo trade
edits.after: Ramp Thundering Smash speed at you and stun with the attack before Frost stacks

edits.before: Sustain through W bite heal in extended fights so your Permafrost stun window never deals enough burst to matter
edits.after: Heal it all back with Frenzied Maul's second bite — 5s flat and it carries on-hit — so your stun window never matters

edits.before: His E hand-of-the-god stun and W heal keep him even; don't over-commit without a full Permafrost chain ready.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields him only if he stands in his own blast, and Frenzied Maul heals every 5s — buy anti-heal.

edits.before: Once you hit Level 6 this lane is comfortably yours. Glacial Prison is a long-range projectile stun — throw it from beyond his Q range, before he can close and smash you with E. If it lands, walk into Arctic Assault range, Q to knock him up, then E to shatter the stacked Frost for a second stun; he cannot heal through two CC windows back-to-back. During Levels 4-5 the lane is roughly even — his E hand-of-the-god stun matches your CC threat and his W heal keeps him healthy in neutral poke. Use this window to farm, keep Permafrost armor stacked by avoiding his Q dash, and set up the Level 6 all-in when his E is down.
edits.after: Once you hit Level 6 this lane is comfortably yours. Glacial Prison is a 1300-unit projectile stun — throw it from beyond Sky Splitter's 1200 range, before he can close and smash you. If it lands, walk into Arctic Assault range, Q to knock him up, then E to shatter the stacked Frost for a second stun; he cannot heal through two CC windows back-to-back. During Levels 4-5 the lane is roughly even — Sky Splitter shields him whenever he stands in his own blast and Frenzied Maul bites back every 5 seconds. Use this window to farm, keep Frost Armor up by staying out of his chip, and set up the Level 6 all-in while Sky Splitter is down.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — The run-down stun — make distance the moment he starts glowing. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget Q dash for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash: 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — the run-down stun; make distance the moment he starts glowing. - Sky Splitter: 16s flat, and it only shields him if he stands in the blast. - Stormbringer: 160s at rank 1.

notes: Best find: the content layer calls Sky Splitter 'his E hand-of-the-god stun' three times. Sky Splitter does not stun — it damages, slows, and shields Volibear only if he is standing inside his own blast radius. Volibear's single stun is Thundering Smash (Q). That fabricated stun is the stated reason the entry concedes levels 4-5, so the error is actively costing the player free trades, and it hides the real read: a Sky Splitter thrown at you that he does not stand in gives him nothing. Second: Thundering Smash is described as a 'Q empowered dash' in four places. It is not a dash — he gains ramping move speed toward enemies and the stun is delivered by his next attack, so the tell is the glow and the attack wind-up, not a leap. Third: 'a full E charge' in the Level 3 spike describes a charge mechanic Sky Splitter does not have; it is a flat 16-second cast. Fourth: Frenzied Maul is 5 seconds flat and applies on-hit, so it stacks with The Relentless Storm's attack speed — flat armour reads the extended trade wrong and Grievous Wounds is the real answer; anti-heal appears nowhere in either layer.
